Anura Kumara Dissanayake, Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development. Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, Colombo 01. April 02, 2026. Regulations 1. These Regulations may be cited as the “Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 03 of 2026”. 2. The Special Import License Regulations No.01 of 2023, Published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2312/77 dated January 01, 2023, as amended subsequently, is hereby further amended. 3. These Regulations are promulgated as per the decision of the Cabinet of Ministers dated March 30, 2026, on the joint Memorandum No. 26/0597/817/017 dated March 26, 2026, of the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development. 1A - PG 7590 - 373 (04/2026) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk 2A I fldgi ( ^I& fPoh - YS% ,xld m%cd;dka;s%l iudcjd§ ckrcfha w;s úfYI .eiÜ m;%h - 2026'04'02 Part I : Sec. (I) - GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA - 02.04.2026 4. Notwithstanding the Special Import License Regulations No. 01 of 2023, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2312/77 dated January 01, 2023, as amended by the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No. 04 of 2025, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2434/12 dated April 29, 2025, the requirement of Import Control License (ICL) shall be exempted for importation of the rice variety known as GR 11 rice including Ponni Samba and Kiri/ Paal Ponni rice considered to be substitutes to Samba and Keeri Samba, respectively and classified under Harmonized System (HS) Code of 1006.30.29 where the on-board date of the said rice consignments shall be indicated in the Bill of Lading between April 02, 2026 and April 30, 2026. Provided that, an importer shall only be allowed to import a maximum quantity of 1,040 MT of GR 11 rice including Ponni Samba and Kiri/Paal Ponni rice considered to be substitutes to Samba and Keeri Samba, respectively with on-board date indicated in the Bill of Lading between April 02, 2026, and April 30, 2026, under these Regulations. 5. The rice consignments referred to in Regulation No. 4 above shall be released from Sri Lanka Customs on or before May 31, 2026. 6. To achieve the objectives of these Regulations, the Controller General of Imports and Exports shall issue “Operational Instructions” to the Director General of Customs, licensed banks or any other relevant authorities. 7. These Regulations shall enter into force with effect from April 02, 2026. EOG 04 - 0042 PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
texts.gazette-2483-04: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2483/04 - 2026 අයේේල් මාස 07 වාැනි අඟහරුවාාදාා - 2026.04.07 No. 2483/04 - TUESDAY, APRIL 07, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE BERUWALA URBAN COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of member of the Beruwala Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of not attending meetings of the Council for a period of three months without permission; And whereas the Leader of the Independent Group, to which Mr. Mohamed Ishhak the member who belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(l)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to nominate a candidate of that Ward Number 03 - China Fort of that Beruwala Urban Council who belongs to such Independent Group and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Leader of the aforesaid Independent Group has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Ahamed Ilman Ahamed Ishkar to fill such vacancy; Therefore I, WannakuwattaWaduge Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, Returning Officer of the Beruwala Urban Council, acting in terms of Section 66A(l)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mr. Ahamed Ilman Ahamed Ishkar was elected as the member of the of Ward Number 03 - China Fort of the Beruwala Urban Council. Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, Returning Officer, Beruwala Urban Council. District Elections Office, Kalutara, 07th of April, 2026. R. M. H. B. Rathnayaka, Returning Officer, Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Kurunegala, 07th April, 2026. texts.gazette-2486-15: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2486/15 - 2026 අයේේල් මාස 28 වාැනි අඟහරුවාාදාා - 2026.04.28 No. 2486/15 - TUESDAY, APRIL 28, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE NEGOMBO MUNICIPAL COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(b) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of a returned member of the Negombo Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of absent three regular meetings continuously without prior permission from the council; And whereas the secretary of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Ms. Saranacharige Dilshani Lalithya Sheni Fernando the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon a candidate of the Negombo Municipal Council who belongs to such Party and who is not disqualified under section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated the decision to nominate Ms. Asarappulige Nirmalee Fernando to fill the said vacancy; Therefore I, Withana Appuhamilage Raviendra Wickramasinghe, Returning Officer of the Negombo Municipal Council, acting in terms of Section 66A (1) (b) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262), do hereby declare that Ms. Asarappulige Nirmalee Fernando was elected as the member of the Negombo Municipal Council. W. A. Raviendra Wickramasinghe, Returning Officer, Negombo Municipal Council. District Election Office, Gampaha, 28th April, 2026.
